description: This file defines custom exception classes related to dashboard operations in the Superset project, including validation errors, creation, update, deletion, and access control errors.

classes.name: DashboardSlugExistsValidationError
classes.description: Validation error indicating the dashboard slug must be unique.

classes.name: DashboardInvalidError
classes.description: Error indicating dashboard parameters are invalid.

classes.name: DashboardNotFoundError
classes.description: Error indicating a dashboard was not found, with optional dashboard ID and exception details.

classes.name: DashboardCreateFailedError
classes.description: Error indicating failure to create a dashboard.

classes.name: DashboardUpdateFailedError
classes.description: Error indicating failure to update a dashboard.

classes.name: DashboardNativeFiltersUpdateFailedError
classes.description: Error indicating failure to update dashboard native filters.

classes.name: DashboardChartCustomizationsUpdateFailedError
classes.description: Error indicating failure to update dashboard chart customizations.

classes.name: DashboardColorsConfigUpdateFailedError
classes.description: Error indicating failure to update dashboard color configuration.

classes.name: DashboardDeleteFailedError
classes.description: Error indicating failure to delete a dashboard.

classes.name: DashboardDeleteEmbeddedFailedError
classes.description: Error indicating failure to delete an embedded dashboard.

classes.name: DashboardDeleteFailedReportsExistError
classes.description: Error indicating there are associated alerts or reports preventing deletion.

classes.name: DashboardForbiddenError
classes.description: Error indicating that changing the dashboard is forbidden.

classes.name: DashboardImportError
classes.description: Error indicating failure to import a dashboard for an unknown reason.

classes.name: DashboardAccessDeniedError
classes.description: Error indicating access to the dashboard is denied.

classes.name: DashboardCopyError
classes.description: Error indicating the dashboard cannot be copied due to invalid parameters.

classes.name: DashboardFaveError
classes.description: Error indicating the dashboard cannot be favorited.

classes.name: DashboardUnfaveError
classes.description: Error indicating the dashboard cannot be unfavorited.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for DashboardSlugExistsValidationError, initializes with a 'Must be unique' message.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for DashboardNotFoundError, initializes with dashboard ID and optional exception.
